name: Moritz Hardt
tuebingen_title_verbatim: Director, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (Managing Director, Social Foundations of Computation department); Honorary Professor, University of Tuebingen
other_positions: None current beyond the MPI-IS/University of Tuebingen dual role; formerly Associate Professor of EECS, UC Berkeley (past)
notes: Not an actual conflict. MPI-IS has both a Tuebingen and a Stuttgart campus, but Hardt's own homepage lists his address as Max-Planck-Ring 4, 72076 Tuebingen, i.e. the Tuebingen campus, and also states he is an Honorary Professor at the University of Tuebingen.
